rationale: Estimated with Synth 1.1.10 using 4 donor units, predictors Z1, Z2 averaged over pre-treatment periods, and lagged Y_observed for each pre-treatment period. Pre-treatment RMSPE was 0.0081. Largest donor weights: donor_d=0.691, donor_a=0.248, donor_b=0.055. ATT is observed minus counterfactual over periods 2006, 2007, 2008.
